name: auto-numbered-title-only-alignment
eligibilityAsImplemented: 1. candidate already survived semantic classification + validator (guaranteed by call-site scoping - only grounded/accepted blocks reach this code)
2. marker recognized by the production marker parser (SourceFactsBuilder.FromPdfBlock, never a new regex)
3. remaining title text non-empty and >= 4 canonical characters
4. candidate's own resolved span (from the span lane, not a heuristic) bounds the heading text before marker stripping, so trailing body-window context is excluded
5. target DOCX paragraph has NumberingId set
6. title-only canonical text finds exactly one NumberingId-bearing paragraph; zero or more than one aborts
prohibited: general strip-and-fuzzy-match, fallback to a non-NumberingId paragraph, resolving an ambiguous duplicate - none implemented

collateralEvidence.verdict: NO_COLLISION_IN_PRACTICE for the 21 real targets checked before this implementation existed; COLLISION_RISK_FOUND at the general-rule level, which is exactly why the rule stays bounded to already-HeadingTopic-validated candidates only

realTargetValidation.verdict: 0/22 - the implementation as specified does not recover any of 057's real undelivered occurrences

whyItDoesNotRecoverAnything: The production marker parser's decimal regex requires a terminating '.' or ')' immediately after the full numeric value. Real PDF-rendered headings like '9.4 Title' (space, no trailing period before the space) only match the FIRST level ('9.'), leaving a stray digit ('4 Title') glued to what should be the clean title - which then never appears as a substring of the real DOCX paragraph text.

Even when the marker IS fully recognized, the span lane's own resolved HeadingSpan for a WindowFragment candidate is imprecise by a few characters at either boundary (observed: missing the final letter of a word, or bleeding a few words into the following sentence) - real model output noise, not a defect in this fix's wiring. Exact-substring matching has zero tolerance for that noise.
notFixed: Neither limitation is addressed here. The marker parser is explicitly out of scope for this fix (must be used as-is, per the frozen eligibility spec); loosening exact-substring matching to tolerate span noise would be a form of fuzzy matching, also explicitly excluded. Both are real, separately-gated pieces of follow-up work, not attempted in R2.

PdfB3RealTargetValidationProbe.CommittedValidationReproduces (locks the real 0/22 result against the actual 057 checkpoint/document, not a reimplementation)
nextStep: See boundedInvestigation below - the two named limitations turned out not to be the whole picture.
promotionDecision: not made by this manifest - reserved for whoever owns the promotion call

boundedInvestigation.scope: Counterfactual only - no production code change. CF1 = looser marker grammar alone (candidate regex, never applied to SourceFactsBuilder). CF2 = HeadingSpan reconciled to its overlapping constituent source line alone, deterministic, no fuzzy matching. CF3 = both.
boundedInvestigation.negativeControlOnLooseMarkerGrammar: 15/44 of 057's own HeadingTopic-classified candidates newly match under the looser grammar where the strict one did not (003: 0/153) - a real, material change in recognition scope, not evaluated case-by-case for correctness here
boundedInvestigation.unplannedFindingTocContamination: Found while investigating CF1-CF3's low recovery, not anticipated when R2 was scoped: the earlier divergence taxonomy (057-pdf-docx-divergence-taxonomy.v1.json) searched an UNFILTERED DOCX paragraph list, which includes table-of-contents listing lines - these repeat a heading's title with a trailing page number and can carry the same NumberingId styling as the real heading. Production alignment (and this fix) correctly excludes InTableOfContents paragraphs. Re-checking all 22 targets: only 13/22 have any real (non-TOC) body paragraph match at all, 11/22 of those also carry NumberingId, and 9/22 targets match ONLY a TOC line - they were never really 'auto-numbered body text' as the original 21/23 figure implied for them specifically.
boundedInvestigation.verdict: R2's true, corrected causal picture is not 'auto-numbering vs PDF-baked marker' alone, as originally diagnosed - marker-grammar depth, span-lane precision, and TOC-line contamination in the original evidence are three separate, compounding factors, and this bounded investigation resolves only 3/22 even combining the first two.
boundedInvestigation.stopConditionReached: Recovering the remaining ~19 would need either fuzzy/tolerant matching (excluded), a document-specific dictionary or heuristic (excluded), or resolving the TOC-contamination question for 9 targets that may have no valid body anchor at all - a different, not-yet-scoped investigation. Per the frozen stop conditions, this bounded investigation ends here without further tuning.
